data: Largest object in the asteroid belt and the only dwarf planet in the inner solar system. Surface ice and water-rich crust suggest a buried ocean. NASA's Dawn spacecraft orbited Ceres from 2015 to 2018, mapping its bright spots in Occator crater (now known to be sodium-carbonate salt deposits left by briny upwelling).
Dawn — NASA, 2015–18 (orbital survey from 1,470 km mapping orbit; gravity, mineralogy, bright spots)
Ceres holds ~25% of the main belt's total mass in a single body — and is the only main-belt object classified as a dwarf planet.
Ceres orbits at 2.77 AU — squarely inside the asteroid belt and used as the canonical "middle of the belt" reference distance.
A planet that almost was — the rocky remnants between Mars and Jupiter that Jupiter's gravity wouldn't let coalesce.
Half the longest diameter of the orbit ellipse — and the single number that sets the orbital period.
